entities.name: Tazri
entities.description: General of the allied forces on Zendikar, former caravan captain who wears the halo of an angel she mercy-killed, and later Commander of Sea Gate.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker who became Commander of the allied forces on Zendikar.

entities.name: Vorik
entities.description: Sea Gate militia captain and military leader who saw Tazri's potential and named Gideon his replacement as he died.

entities.name: Drana
entities.description: A vampire who joined Gideon and Tazri's efforts; later a vampire queen.

entities.name: Munda
entities.description: A kor squad leader who fought alongside Tazri.

entities.name: Jori En
entities.description: A merfolk who brought news that Ulamog was approaching Sea Gate.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker who met Tazri while the Eldrazi were stopped.

entities.name: Kiora
entities.description: A planeswalker who helped plan the fight against Ulamog.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who returned from the Eye of Ugin with the hedron network plan.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: A demon planeswalker who disrupted the hedron network.

entities.name: Noyan Dar
entities.description: A roilmage who regrouped with Tazri.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker who arrived as Tazri's group located Ob Nixilis.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan whose brood took Sea Gate.

entities.name: Kozilek
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan woken after Ulamog was freed.

entities.name: Linvala
entities.description: An angel who backed Tazri's Sea Gate plan and fought Nahiri.

entities.name: Akiri
entities.description: Sent by Tazri to investigate Nahiri's return.

entities.name: Kaza
entities.description: Sent by Tazri to investigate Nahiri's return.

entities.name: Orah
entities.description: Sent by Tazri to investigate Nahiri's return.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A planeswalker whose return in the Emeri Skyclave Tazri foresaw; defeated by the party.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: City on Tazeem that was the allied bastion on Zendikar, retaken by Tazri's forces and rebuilt.

entities.name: Sky Rock
entities.description: A floating hedron where a new camp was established.

entities.name: Emeri Skyclave
entities.description: Transformed Skyclave where Nahiri was fought.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane Tazri defends.

entities.name: Eye of Ugin
entities.description: Location from which Jace returned with the hedron plan.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The group of planeswalkers who defeated the titans at Zendikar's Last Stand.

entities.name: Battle for Zendikar
entities.description: The war against the Eldrazi on Zendikar.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion that made Zendikar a target.

events.summary: As a caravan captain Tazri finds a wounded angel and kills her as an act of mercy, taking her halo, and is cursed.
events.quote: She killed the angel as an act of mercy and took the angel's halo as a way to remember her.

events.summary: Tazri falls on bad times and joins the Sea Gate militia, where Vorik sees her potential.
events.quote: She immediately caught the interest of militia captain Vorik

events.summary: Sea Gate is overtaken by the Eldrazi; Tazri meets Gideon Jura at a refugee camp.
events.quote: She first met Gideon Jura in a refugee camp outside the city, after a battle with Ulamog's spawn.

events.summary: Vorik dies of his injuries and, against Tazri's wishes, names Gideon as his replacement.
events.quote: contrary to Tazri's wishes, he named Gideon as his replacement.

events.summary: Tazri joins Gideon, Drana and Munda to retake Sea Gate; a failure kills many Zendikari but Sea Gate is reclaimed after training.
events.quote: Despite her worries, Sea Gate was reclaimed after intensive training

events.summary: Jori En warns that Ulamog is approaching Sea Gate.
events.quote: the Eldrazi titan Ulamog himself was approaching Sea Gate.

events.summary: Tazri meets Nissa and Kiora and urges evacuation while Gideon, Drana and Kiora plan to fight the titan; Jace proposes trapping Ulamog with the hedron network.
events.quote: saying Ulamog could be trapped using an aligned hedron network.

events.summary: Ulamog is trapped, but Ob Nixilis disrupts the network, freeing Ulamog and waking Kozilek.
events.quote: the demon planeswalker Ob Nixilis appeared and disrupted the network, leaving Ulamog to ravage the city and waking Kozilek as well.

events.summary: Saved by her halo, Tazri regroups with Noyan Dar, Drana and Munda and takes command, leading to Chandra's arrival.
events.quote: inspired by the angel she had killed so long ago, took command.

events.summary: Tazri survives Zendikar's Last Stand in which the Gatewatch defeat the titans, and leads rebuilding.
events.quote: She survived Zendikar's Last Stand with Ulamog and Kozilek

events.summary: Fed up with the expeditionary houses' infighting, Tazri drafts her own plan for Sea Gate, which Linvala backs, and the city is restored within a year.
events.quote: Fed up with the houses' infighting, Tazri drafted a plan of her own.

events.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion Tazri leads the defense of Sea Gate and sends Akiri, Linvala, Kaza and Orah to investigate her vision of Nahiri's return.
events.quote: She received a halo-blessed vision of the return of Nahiri

events.summary: Tazri and the party attack Nahiri in the Emeri Skyclave, break her loose from the Hedron network, and the Skyclave crashes with Nahiri inside.
events.quote: they witnessed the Skyclave breaking and crashing to the ground with Nahiri still inside.

relations.note: Trusted advisor and later general under Commander Gideon.
relations.quote: was a trusted advisor to Commander Gideon Jura .

relations.note: Saw her potential as a leader.
relations.quote: who saw her potential as a leader
The angel Linvala immediately stood behind her proposal

relations.note: Helped recapture Sea Gate from his brood.
relations.quote: Tazri was instrumental in the recapture of Sea Gate from the Eldrazi titan Ulamog 's brood.
Tazri joined the others to attack Nahiri in the heart of the transformed Emeri Skyclave .

relations.note: Disrupted the plan and held planeswalker captives.
relations.quote: Ob Nixilis and his planeswalker captives

relations.note: Took over as Commander of Sea Gate.
relations.quote: She took over as Commander of Sea Gate when Gideon left the plane after the defeat of the Eldrazi.
